class.name: LocalLinkConditions
class.brief_description: Declarative inbound impairment for one loopback link.
class.description: One spec describes a link in human units and feeds the simulator directly, so there is no compile step. [member latency_ms], [member jitter_ms] and [member packet_loss] are read at receive time and never quantized to the physics rate, which is what keeps a latency shorter than one frame expressible. [codeblock] var conditions := LocalLinkConditions.wifi() conditions.packet_loss = 0.05 session.set_link_conditions(server, conditions) [/codeblock] [member packet_loss] drops an unreliable packet outright. A reliable one is never dropped, and pays [method effective_retransmit_ms] instead. [member seed] names the random streams this spec draws from, so two runs of the same scenario deliver packets in the same order.

method.name: clone
method.description: Returns a copy of this spec. [method LocalLoopbackSession.set_link_conditions] clones what it is given, so editing a spec after installing it changes nothing.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a spec seeded with [param seed]. A registered class's [code]new()[/code] takes no arguments, so this is where a seed goes.

method.name: effective_retransmit_ms
method.description: Returns how long a lost reliable packet waits before it arrives anyway. While [member retransmit_ms] stays negative this derives from [member latency_ms].

method.name: perfect
method.description: Returns a link with no simulated impairment.

members.member: Probability that an unreliable packet is delivered a second time, one period later.
Upper bound on the extra delay drawn per unreliable packet.
Probability that a packet is lost. An unreliable packet is dropped; a reliable one is delayed by [method effective_retransmit_ms].
Probability that an unreliable packet is held one extra period, which is what puts it behind the packet sent after it.
How long a lost reliable packet is delayed. Negative means derive it from [member latency_ms], which is what [method effective_retransmit_ms] does.
Seeds every random stream this spec draws from. The same seed and the same scenario produce the same delivery order.
Probability of opening a throttle window, during which nothing is delivered.
How long a throttle window lasts, in milliseconds.
